title: Claim-conditioned mandatory checkpoint roles
theorem_contract: A checkpoint role is mandatory only relative to an endpoint claim class.
Requiring irrelevant roles increases friction without increasing correctness.
A stronger claim activates a superset of barriers.
Reachability claims retain the full four-role protocol.
invariant: Absolute checkpoints are claim-relative: retain every barrier required to justify the requested endpoint, and no compulsory barrier that cannot affect that endpoint's correctness.
boundary: The mapping from claim class to role set is an HF01 design contract and may evolve if new failure classes appear.
